0022600166.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-5, 14th in the East) are on a two-game losing streak and are 0-2 on the road, while the Minnesota Timberwolves (4-3, 9th in the West) have lost their last game and are 2-1 at home. Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery) will not play for Minnesota, and Rudy Gobert is day-to-day with back spasms and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season series, most recently 139-106 in Milwaukee on January 13, 2026.
